note: Chapter-keyed spine shared with the sequel. `mustLand` flags the fifteen scenes novel readers judge the game on (§3.1). `day` is the in-game calendar day the beat sits on, which drives seasons, weather and the upkeep clock.

calendar.note: Day 1 is the morning Fang Yuan wakes in the bamboo room. The year-end duel sits at the turn of the year; the winter missions and the wolf tide follow the season, not the chapter count.

acts.name: Awakening
acts.spine: Rebirth, awakening, the Liquor worm, extortion, Jia Jin Sheng.

acts.name: Inheritance
acts.spine: The inquiry, the inheritance trials, the year-end duel, winter, the secret Rank two.

acts.name: Assets and the wolf tide
acts.spine: Family assets, the tavern and the leaves, Four Flavours, the wolf tide, Qing Shu.

acts.name: The mountain falls
acts.spine: Rank three, the investigation, the founder and Sky Crane, the blood curtain, the escape.

mustLand.title: The last stand of the first life and the Cicada
mustLand.treatment: Playable prologue at full power against hopeless odds, ending in the rebirth. He then wakes in the bamboo room, weak.

mustLand.title: Awakening: C grade against an A grade
mustLand.treatment: Staged ceremony with crowd reactions and Fang Yuan's inner reading of it.

mustLand.title: Liquor worm, the cave, and the Cicada revealed
mustLand.treatment: Several nights of searching, the image wall, and the Cicada's pressure as a set piece.

mustLand.title: Academy extortion and the Mo confrontation
mustLand.treatment: A recurring toll, an escalation arc, and a negotiation where composure is the weapon.

mustLand.title: Jia Jin Sheng in the night, then the inquiry
mustLand.treatment: Stealth, evidence cleanup, then an inquiry whose difficulty depends on what was left behind.

mustLand.title: Inheritance trials
mustLand.treatment: Boar strength, the boulder, the stone monkeys. The stone forest gets a ceiling and real darkness.

mustLand.title: Year-end duel against Fang Zheng
mustLand.treatment: A multi-phase boss that rewards reading his defences rather than out-damaging them.

mustLand.title: Winter missions and the secret Rank two
mustLand.treatment: Play the group losses and the boar-king survival. The secrecy feeds the exposure system.

mustLand.title: Taking the family assets
mustLand.treatment: The full political squeeze, then the property loop.

mustLand.title: Qing Shu's last stand
mustLand.treatment: Keep the observer framing; give it the staging and the time it deserves.

mustLand.title: Yao Le and the Rank-three breakthrough
mustLand.treatment: The choice on screen, the act off screen, the breakthrough as a full ritual, then the clan's search.

mustLand.title: Tie Ruo Nan's investigation
mustLand.treatment: The payoff of the exposure system: she works the player's actual trail.

mustLand.title: The founder, the blood lake, Lord Sky Crane
mustLand.treatment: Bigger spaces; stage the fight between two powers clearly.

mustLand.title: The blood curtain and the second Cicada activation
mustLand.treatment: A cinematic sequence with a fixed outcome. Not a combat arena.

mustLand.title: Bai's transformation, the raft, no healing Gu

milestones.event: Fang Yuan wakes in the bamboo room after five hundred years.
Awakening. Hope Gu opens the aperture; C grade, a forty-four percent primeval sea.
Fang Zheng's A grade is read out to the same crowd.
Moonlight Gu from the Gu room.
First purchase of Green Bamboo Wine, at the price the text states.
The Liquor worm is secured under the Cicada's pressure.
The academy toll begins.
The Mo negotiation closes.
The purple-gold fossil becomes the Liquor worm's origin story.
Jia Jin Sheng does not come back down the mountain.
Rank one middle stage.
Jia Fu's inquiry ends without a finding. He still means to send for an investigator.
White Boar Gu from the first Earth Treasury Flower.
The beast-skin map changes hands.
The boulder, and Jade Skin Gu beyond it.
The stone forest and the jade-eye monkeys.
The year-end duel. Fang Zheng's defences come apart.
The permafrost decayed-soil task is accepted.
Rank two, in secret, at Jiang He's place. Red-steel essence.
The beast crossing. Most of Jiao San's group does not return.
White Jade Gu, improved by the boar king's snowy tusk.
The family assets come away from Fang Qiu.
The Four Flavours Liquor worm.
Qing Shu's position falls. Fang Yuan watches.
Rank three. White-silver essence. Yao Le does not return to the village.
The council acknowledges a young Rank three elder.
Tie Ruo Nan's theory is wrong, and it is a near miss.
The founder against Lord Sky Crane. Fang Zheng is carried toward Central Continent.
The blood curtain. The Cicada is used for the second and last time.
The raft on the Yellow Dragon River. Rank one, no healing Gu, the Southern Border ahead.

threads.summary: Fang Zheng carried off toward Central Continent, alive and out of reach.
The Yang Gu is still Fang Yuan's, and Bai Ning Bing knows it.
No healing Gu. Every injury from here is a logistics problem.
Back to Rank one after holding Rank three peak. He knows exactly what he has lost.
The Southern Border ahead, chosen rather than fled to.
